text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Visitor flow lines are all set... and that 
does it. The painting layout is decided 
too, so all that's left is to get 
Ramonu-san's final check.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Ryan. You've really helped me out 
with so many things for Ramonu-san's 
exhibition...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it, don't mention it! I'm 
really looking forward to Ramonu-san's 
exhibition too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...What's the matter, Dober? You look a 
bit down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ramonu-san's paintings are so intense, 
so terrifying. And yet—you can't help but 
be captivated by them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I probably could never paint something 
so powerful. That maddening, 
obsession-like passion...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see... Ramonu-san's paintings really are 
amazing, aren't they! It's like they have 
this overwhelming power that strikes 
straight to the heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still... when it comes to strong feelings, 
you have them too, don't you, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see... Ah! Do you remember 
that tea party? Back when we were all 
still little... When Ramonu-san was 
finally able to run again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You said it right to her face back then, 
didn't you, Dober—?

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win a GⅠ race someday too!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll even beat you, Ramonu-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes were so intense back then! They 
were positively blazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But you stared right back without 
flinching. ...I remember it clearly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, really...? I actually said 
something like that to Ramonu-san...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... Could that have been before I 
took that fall in a race...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, I don't really remember it 
well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that reminds me! During that tea 
party, you drew a picture of everyone, 
Dober. If you look at that drawing, maybe 
you'll remember!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I think... it was around here... Maybe 
this one?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the one! That's it! Fufu, you 
drew yourself right in the center! And 
you're the biggest one, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... You're right. Who draws themselves 
right in the middle? Is that normal?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, it's definitely not ordinary. It's 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Back then, you truly believed from the 
bottom of your heart that 'I am number 
one,' Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: From the bottom of my heart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the evening, seeing an empty classroom 
door ajar, I checked inside and found 
Mejiro Dober staring intently at Mejiro 
Ramonu's painting.
choice_data_list: You're looking at that quite intently.
You're looking at that quite intently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-Don't call out to me all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you startled me. I didn't notice you 
at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking at Ramonu-san's painting. 
Don't disturb me. ...Because there's 
something I need to make sure of.
choice_data_list:
Are you planning to challenge Ramonu to a 
match?

Are you planning to challenge Ramonu to a 
match?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was looking at Ramonu-san's painting. 
...To make sure of the strength of my own 
feelings.
choice_data_list:
Are you planning to challenge Ramonu to a 
match?

Are you planning to challenge Ramonu to a 
match?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ramonu-san's painting is filled with 
such intense... raw passion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Ramonu-san's painting is filled 
with such intense... raw passion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But even in me, there's—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm trying to make sure of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Not that it has anything to do with 
you.
choice_data_list:
I'll keep an eye on the painting, so go on 
ahead.

I'll watch the painting, why don't you go 
ahead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Though I don't know if she'll even give 
me the time of day...
choice_data_list:
I'll keep an eye on the painting, so go on 
ahead.

I'll watch the painting, why don't you go 
ahead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! I told you it's none of your—ah, 
geez! Whatever you do, don't touch or move 
the painting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...! Th-Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ramonu-san! Um...! Would you please do 
a tandem training run with me!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—A fledgling chick at long last, are we? 
Crying out with a loud voice, begging for 
love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Once you come to know the sky, 
fly your way to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-Yes, ma'am!!
